transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Hello! I'm Dora. I've just completed your post-cataract surgery follow-up check. 

Do you have any questions about your surgery or recovery that I can help you with?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi Dora! Yes, I do have a few questions. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Great question! You can start doing light gardening after 1 week following your surgery. However, you should avoid any strenuous or heavy exercise for a full month after your operation.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you, that's helpful to know. My next question is, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
That's a good question. If you were using eye gel for dry eyes before your operation, it's safe to continue using it now, unless you've been told otherwise by your doctor.

If you're unsure about anything specific regarding your eye gel, I'd recommend checking with your care team to confirm.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thanks, I'll make sure to check with my care team. Another thing I've noticed is that I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Yes, that's quite normal! It's common for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as they adjust to your new lenses. If it's mild and things just seem brighter than you're used to, I'd recommend wearing sunglasses when you're outside.

However, if you're experiencing significant pain in bright light, or if your eye is also red and painful, that's not normal and we may need to assess it further. In that case, do let your care team know.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thanks, I'll keep that in mind. My last question is, should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
That depends on how long it's been since your surgery. It's quite common for vision to not be completely clear in the first week after your operation, but this should improve quickly and settle down over time.

If your vision is still blurry or getting significantly worse, we may need to check it to make sure everything's okay.

How long ago was your surgery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: My surgery was about a week ago, so it's reassuring to know that some blurriness is normal at this stage. Thank you for all the information. I don't have any more questions right now.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Brilliant! So just to confirm - have all your questions about your cataract surgery recovery been answered today?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, all my questions have been answered. Thank you so much for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're very welcome! I'm glad I could help. Take care, and best of luck with your recovery!
